name: Inflection Historical Dimension Backfill (~6yr Orion API)
description: Backfill Inflection/Orion API dimension tables (accounts_v2, household, household_rep_mapping, billing, activity, performance, positions_mv, assets_v2) to match `silver/transactions/` origin (2020-05-26; 1,502 files, ~6 years). Today every dim has at most 2 snapshots (last week of 2026-04). Lookback analysis joining transactions to dims uses today's snapshot for historical dates — this misattributes any transaction prior to a rep/account change. Phase 0 capability probe is the central unknown: Orion API accepts `--start/--end/--snapshot-date` parameters for some endpoints (e.g. `transactions` accepts `createdDateStart`) but others may be current-state-only. Probe outputs a per-dim eligibility matrix with provable earliest date. Phase 1+ scope (bronze backfill, silver convert, gold rerun) sized post-probe.

phase: Phase 0 — registered 2026-04-30; Andrew rulings 2026-04-30 PM resolve all 4 open questions; no TOs authored yet (Andrew + COO will handle sequencing). **Andrew rulings:** (1) Backfill date target = match `silver/transactions/` origin 2020-05-26 for every vector; if a dim's earliest available history is later than 2020-05-26, NOTE explicitly per dim (no obligation to invent data). (2) Priority order doesn't matter — all 8 dims will be backfilled regardless; sequence by ops convenience. (3) **Off-the-books operation** — no Orion support contact available; Option C in JWTRES (and any vendor-confirmed answers in HISTBF Phase 0) deferred indefinitely. Rate limiting via empirical adaptive strategy: **linear acceleration with linear fallback** — start at very polite low rate, scale up iteratively per success; on any 401/429/5xx, drop linearly (fallback faster than acceleration to dampen oscillation); persist observed-stable rate across runs. Goal: be polite to Orion's system. (4) JWTRES Phase 1 ships first; Phase 0 probe runs in parallel with JWTRES Phase 1 (read-only probe doesn't burn JWT capacity). 4-phase scope from AE brief §2 unchanged: Phase 0 API capability probe (DS, 1-2d) → Phase 1 bronze backfill (DS+AE, sized post-probe + rate-limit observation) → Phase 2 silver backfill (DS, parallelizable) → Phase 3 gold rerun (DS+AE, scope TBD).
blocking: Andrew + COO sequencing call (Andrew handling directly per 2026-04-30 PM ruling — `I'll handle that with COO ... we will try to thread these simultaneously parallelizing what we can`). Phase 0 probe authorization is the immediate gate. Off-the-books framing means probe is purely empirical: observe response patterns across date ranges per dim, infer as-of support from response shape; no vendor-confirmed answers.
lane_note: DS primary owner — script extension (--backfill-start/--backfill-end flags), per-dim probe execution, silver convert orchestration. AE 0.6.1 + AE 0.7 secondary — EC2 sizing for multi-day backfill, rate-limit observation, S3 storage cost monitoring. CTO architectural sponsor.
